name: Hatha Week at Stonefield
summary: A week of twice-daily taught hatha yoga and pranayama for 10, on a fixed timetable, silent until lunch. Moderate physically. Some yoga experience needed. £395.
description:
Stonefield is a converted barn and a teacher, Petra Lindqvist, who has taught hatha and pranayama for 22 years. Ten students, one week, a fixed timetable.

**Timetable**
6.30 pranayama and sitting. 7.30 asana (2 hrs). Breakfast. 11.00 asana theory or a short practice. Lunch. Free afternoon until 16.30. 16.30 asana (90 min). Supper. 19.30 chanting or a talk. Attendance at the morning and afternoon practices is expected.

**Silence**
Until lunch, including the morning practices; Petra teaches, you do not speak. Afternoons and evenings are ordinary and conversational.

**Level**
Not for complete beginners. You should have at least a year of regular practice and be comfortable with a two-hour session. Petra teaches to the group but adjusts individually.

**Physical**
Moderate. Two long asana sessions a day, walking the moor in the afternoons if you like.

**Cost**
£395 including shared room and meals.
practical: Saturday to Saturday, eight weeks a year. £395. 10 places, shared twin rooms. Three vegetarian meals. Mats and props provided; bring your own if preferred. Bring walking boots and waterproofs for the afternoons. Nearest station Buxton; we collect. Wifi in the kitchen.
